Class CellRecord

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.vault.CellRecord
public final class CellRecord extends Object
The CellRecord class is one cell on a canvas. A burner cell is an ephemeral cell, and an ephemeral cell stores null text columns. The id and canvasId fields start empty. The branchId field starts as main. The state field starts as CellState.INCLUDED. The userText and assistantText fields start empty. // @aa-sdd S1-09 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md

      public boolean headLock
      The flag is the packed-prefix lock on this cell. An old row that has no stored lock reads as unlocked.

    • ephemeral

      public boolean ephemeral

    • readable

      public boolean readable
      The flag is false when the stored state token is not one of the four states. A false flag leaves the cell out of the source list.

    • groupId

      public String groupId
      The id groups cells that were sent together. An empty id means the cell stands alone. Cells that share a non-empty id are one group.

    • executionStatus

      public String executionStatus
      The status is the last run of this cell. An empty value means the cell has not run. The stored tokens are COMPLETED, FAILED, and CANCELLED.
